packet_conflict_resolution.rationale: Current exact German manufacturer formula is canonical under the v1.4 hierarchy. The dm same-GTIN delta affects colorants/fragrance/exposure details and shifts amodimethicone late; it preserves the property-bearing surfactant, silicone/polymer, sodium hyaluronate, acid and anti-dandruff-active architecture.

explicit_conflicts.description: Use current exact German manufacturer formula as canonical source under v1.4 hierarchy; preserve dm exact-GTIN formula as resolved non-material conflict evidence and do not merge formulas. Resolved as non-material for the eight v1.4 properties: the two formulas preserve the same primary surfactant system, early glycol distearate, silicone/cationic-polymer routes, sodium hyaluronate, acids and absence of recognized v1.4 dandruff actives. The delta is limited to colorants/fragrance/exposure details and amodimethicone shifting from late position 23 to late position 25.
